results.reason: While record DMS-00001406 asserts that an IT recovery exercise was conducted ('erfüllt') and quarterly backup restores run regularly, the actual operational test report with measured restore times and recovery targets (RTO/RPO) is absent from the data. Under 17-AUS-17, a register assertion without underlying operational metrics cannot establish full compliance.
supported_aspects: Formal obligation and proof document exists (DMS-00001406).
Quarterly offline backup restore controls are active (4 effective runs out of 5).
shortfall_or_missing_aspects: Underlying test log with measured recovery times (RTO) and restore targets is missing.
The 2025-10-13 DR exercise execution is rated only 'teilweise wirksam' in the internal controls register.

results.reason: Individual technical controls (patching, phishing, access checks) are periodically tested and tracked. However, an overarching effectiveness assessment program covering all company operations and OT systems is absent. Per 17-AUS-17, discrete tests and a site-limited ISO certificate (Frankfurt DC only) do not establish full entity-wide effectiveness.
supported_aspects: Specific technical controls undergo monthly/quarterly execution tracking (patching, phishing).
ISO 27001 certification covers Frankfurt data center systems.
shortfall_or_missing_aspects: No comprehensive effectiveness testing plan (penetration testing, technical audits) for production plants (Marl, Bitterfeld).
No independent verification of effectiveness across the full scope of § 30 BSIG measures.
